PRIMARY EVIDENCE FOR DECISION D-004 AND GAP G-001
=================================================

$ nvidia-smi
nvidia-smi : The term 'nvidia-smi' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script
file, or operable program.
    + CategoryInfo          : ObjectNotFound: (nvidia-smi:String) [], CommandNotFoundException

$ Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select Name, DriverVersion
{"Name":"AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics","DriverVersion":"31.0.21924.61"}

# Inside the container, after D-008:
$ python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"
False

CONCLUSION
  The only GPU is the Ryzen 5650U's integrated AMD Radeon (Vega class). There is no NVIDIA
  device and therefore no CUDA. ROCm has no Windows support for this class of iGPU either.

CONSEQUENCES
  * Triton (Project 5) cannot be compiled or benchmarked on this machine. The kernel is authored
    here and executed on an external free GPU runtime; until it has actually run, the project
    page states "authored, not yet executed" and publishes no timings. (D-004)
  * All training for all eight projects is CPU training. Scale is bounded by wall clock.
  * Any GPU performance claim anywhere in this portfolio must name the external hardware it was
    measured on. None may be attributed to this laptop.
